svg.title: The encoder is a property of the model
svg.desc: Three columns: paired raw and scaled accuracy bars showing KNN gaining 35.9 points and a boosted tree gaining nothing from standardising, a forty-level category fanning into one-hot, ordinal and target encodings with logistic regression gaining 9.77 AUC points from one-hot while HistGB gains 0.23, and three target-encoding schemes of which the 0.7471 full-dataset version and the 0.6234 reused-fold version are struck out leaving out-of-fold at 0.6423.
svg.text: The encoder is a property of the model
trees split on ORDER, never on
property of the MODEL, not of
encode on the train fold, reuse
WORSE than no feature at all (0.6318)
hashing trades a little accuracy for a fixed-width,
no-vocabulary encoder that never has to be refitted.
...and features built out of TIME? -> M2
